description:
This mod is a modding Library that allow a lot of things for mods :[list]
[*]Access the informations of other mods in a local game like :[list]
[*]their differents sets (shape, tool, harvestable...),
[*]their custom Crafting recipes (craftbot, cookbot and trader).
[*]Have all the informations of a part that are in his shapeset (size, flammable, stacksize, set path, original mod Id...),
[*]Introduce an all new tag system like Minecraft, if you want to check an item property, check if it's in a tag that specify this property (this depends on if modders registered their item tags, register your tags in the GFolder accessible from the github)
[*]A native integration of custom connection types
[*][i]New things might be coming soon [/i]

For any suggestion/problems/questions, feel free to message me or ping on a server that I'm in on Discord : "[b]@_1g__[/b]"

For additional informations, check the Github :
https://github.com/ClashofCraft972/CompatLib/wiki/Compatibility-Library-Wiki
